name: b1-sync-latency-1room-100clients
title: Sync edit-to-peer latency: 1 room(s) x 100 clients

git.commit_note: branch main has no commits yet; numbers come from the uncommitted working tree

environment.docker_desktop_note: Docker Desktop on Windows: containers run in the WSL2 VM; Redis/Postgres/Qdrant and sandboxes cross the Windows<->VM boundary

conditions.topology: 2 sync nodes (:4111, :4112) behind the Node round-robin LB (:4110); Redis Pub/Sub relay (Redis 7 in Docker Desktop, :6380)
conditions.client: y-protocols over ws (Node v22.15.1), 4 loader processes
conditions.measured: receiver wall-clock (performance.timeOrigin+now) minus sender timestamp embedded in the edit; every peer of every edit
conditions.load_generator: same machine as both nodes, the LB, Redis and Postgres
conditions.k6: not used: k6's goja runtime cannot run the yjs/y-protocols libraries

protocol: 1 warm-up run (5 edits/client) + 3 measured runs; fresh rooms each run; 3 s drain before collecting
notes: Samples include same-node and cross-node peers; per-run breakdown is in runs[].extra.same_node / cross_node.
deliveries_missing counts edit deliveries not observed within the 3 s drain.
